write_set_policy.rule: a WorkOrder may mutate only paths inside its admitted proposed_bounded_write_set
write_set_policy.remediation_note: Defect W0-002-WS-001: an earlier pass wrote src/ and tools/ outside this write-set; those files were deleted and are recorded in the corrective receipt.

w2_note: The W2 admitted write-set is enforced by RE-READING the on-disk paths after the write and failing if any touched path falls outside the declared set. The set is never widened to fit a stray path: an out-of-set path is a defect to be deleted and receipted, not an entry to be added.
invariants: provider/execution state is never semantic authority (PI-PKG-00 2.4)
